def compute_model_placement(gpu_num, models):
    """Place largest models by projected KVPR, then greedily improve bottlenecks."""
    placement = {i: [] for i in range(gpu_num)}
    free = [GPU_MEM_SIZE] * gpu_num
    load = [0.0] * gpu_num

    # Large-first placement avoids fragmentation; projected KVPR accounts for
    # both the added request pressure and the memory consumed by a model.
    for model in sorted(
        models, key=lambda m: (m.model_size, m.req_rate / m.slo), reverse=True
    ):
        size = model.model_size
        pressure = model.req_rate / model.slo
        best = min(
            (i for i in range(gpu_num) if size <= free[i]),
            key=lambda i: (
                (load[i] + pressure) / (free[i] - size)
                if free[i] > size else float("inf")
            ),
            default=None,
        )
        if best is None:
            raise ValueError("Models do not fit in available GPU memory")
        placement[best].append(model)
        free[best] -= size
        load[best] += pressure

    # Repeatedly make the feasible relocation with the largest exact reduction
    # in the maximum KVPR across all GPUs.
    for _ in range(len(models)):
        ratios = [load[i] / free[i] if free[i] else float("inf")
                  for i in range(gpu_num)]
        best_score = max(ratios)
        best_move = None

        for src in range(gpu_num):
            for model in placement[src]:
                size = model.model_size
                pressure = model.req_rate / model.slo
                for dst in range(gpu_num):
                    if src == dst or size > free[dst]:
                        continue
                    dst_free = free[dst] - size
                    dst_ratio = ((load[dst] + pressure) / dst_free

                        (load[src] - pressure) / (free[src] + size)

        placement[dst].append(model)
        free[src] += size

def compute_model_placement(gpu_num, models):
    """Place largest models by projected KVPR, then greedily improve bottlenecks."""
    placement = {i: [] for i in range(gpu_num)}
    free = [GPU_MEM_SIZE] * gpu_num
    load = [0.0] * gpu_num

    # Large-first placement avoids fragmentation; projected KVPR accounts for
    # both the added request pressure and the memory consumed by a model.
    for model in sorted(
        models, key=lambda m: (m.model_size, m.req_rate / m.slo), reverse=True
    ):
        size = model.model_size
        pressure = model.req_rate / model.slo
        best = min(
            (i for i in range(gpu_num) if size <= free[i]),
            key=lambda i: (
                (load[i] + pressure) / (free[i] - size)
                if free[i] > size else float("inf")
            ),
            default=None,
        )
        if best is None:
            raise ValueError("Models do not fit in available GPU memory")
        placement[best].append(model)
        free[best] -= size
        load[best] += pressure

    # Repeatedly make the feasible relocation with the largest exact reduction
    # in the maximum KVPR across all GPUs.
